text: Federation Square.
Federation Square.
不是建筑之间剩下的空地，而是铁路之上被共同建造的城市地面。
A civic ground deliberately built over railway infrastructure, rather than space left between buildings.

text: 面积必须按统计边界阅读：Karres en Brands公布广场7,500 m²，并另列约45,000 m²项目范围及4.5公顷任务规模；Bates Smart公布44,000 m²项目面积。三者不是同一口径，不能相加、互换，或从照片反算广场净面积。

Read areas by their boundaries: Karres en Brands publishes a 7,500 m² square, an approximately 45,000 m² project and a 4.5 ha assignment. Bates Smart lists 44,000 m². These scopes are not interchangeable and are neither added nor inferred from photographs.

Date scopes: Bates Smart lists project completion in 2002; Karres en Brands lists 2004 in its Construction field. Both source fields are retained rather than treating the landscape assignment date as the opening date of the entire square.
城市位置：网格、车站与河流之间
Urban context: between grid, station and river
区位图与河侧鸟瞰共同定位：北面是Flinders Street与CBD，西侧经Swanston Street／Princes Bridge连接车站和南岸，东侧为铁路走廊及相邻公共空间，南面指向Yarra／Birrarung。它既承担文化目的地，也处在城市穿行路线中；“穿过”与“留下”必须分开研究。

Read the location drawing with the river-side aerial: Flinders Street and the CBD lie to the north; Swanston Street and Princes Bridge connect the station and south bank to the west; rail and adjacent public spaces lie east; the Yarra/Birrarung lies south. Destination visits and through journeys require separate study.

title: 01 / 地面
01 / Ground
text: 广场首先是一项基础设施转换：平台让公共空间跨越铁路；平面不能独自解释这种立体关系。
The deck changes the infrastructural condition. A plan alone cannot explain the resulting vertical relationships.

title: 02 / 边界
02 / Edges
text: 室外广场、Atrium与文化机构入口形成不同开放条件，玻璃透明性与公共可进入性不能直接画等号。
Plaza, Atrium and institutional entrances have different access conditions. Transparency does not establish public access.

title: 03 / 使用
03 / Use

Study informal sitting, events, festivals and assemblies separately. One crowded photograph cannot represent annual performance.

History: design, completion and public value

Reading route: drawings and 2020 figure-ground, then connectivity, edges and public life, followed by an evidence-based evaluation. Findings and gaps are published together.
在铁路上盖上，建筑实体、公共平台和可通行地面是三个不同对象。

官方数据生成的真实Figure Ground
True figure-ground from official data
数据链：City of Melbourne的2020 Building Footprints → 有效的intersects空间相交查询 → 分页取回1001条tier=1记录 → 排除94条Bridge记录 → 保留907条Structure记录 → 本地等距近似投影 → 保存GeoJSON快照与SVG。页面不再等待远程GIS接口才显示图纸。

Data chain: City of Melbourne 2020 Building Footprints → valid intersects query → all 1,001 tier-1 records paginated → 94 Bridge records excluded → 907 Structure records retained → local metric projection → frozen GeoJSON and SVG. The drawing renders without a remote GIS request.
官方定义包含建筑墙体与地面或基座相交的轮廓，多层建筑按tier分层。tier=1不保证每处都是同一街道标高；广场上盖和建筑平台必须结合剖面解释。未覆盖或未分类的白色空间不能当作已测量的广场净面积。

The official footprint meets ground or podium; tiers represent changes in built form. Tier 1 does not guarantee a single street elevation everywhere. Read podium and deck with sections. Unclassified white areas are not a measured net plaza area.

text: 原始平面：保持层级，不把不同楼层压平
Original plan: preserve levels rather than flatten them
图中Plaza、St Paul’s Court、North Atrium、South Atrium／Amphitheatre、ACMI、NGV和Public Circulation有独立编号。组合图适合判断功能邻接和空间序列；它不提供已审计的连续可步行边界，不能直接生成VGA或计算开放空间率。

The numbered key distinguishes Plaza, St Paul’s Court, North Atrium, South Atrium/Amphitheatre, ACMI, NGV and public circulation. It supports programme adjacency and sequence, but supplies no audited continuous walkable boundary for VGA or open-space ratios.
两张真实剖面：从平台到城市尺度
Two real sections: from deck to city

title: 平台与铁路
Deck and railway
text: 剖面把铁路基础设施与上部公共地面同时显示。它能解释立体重叠，不能替代结构安全、净空或振动报告。
The section shows rail below civic ground. It explains superposition, not structural safety, clearance certification or vibration performance.

title: 体量与天际线
Mass and skyline
text: 城市剖面还包含教堂、车站及背景建筑；部分为投影立面，部分切过室内。不可把所有线条当成同一切割面的实墙。
The urban section includes cathedral, station and background buildings, combining projections and cuts. Not every line represents a wall at one section plane.

title: 高差与路径
Level changes and routes
text: 原图可读出公共地面与室内文化空间的层级关系；具体坡比、无障碍连续性及标高仍需带标注原件或现场核验。
The drawing explains relationships between public ground and interiors. Gradients, accessible continuity and levels still need annotated originals or field checks.
图纸状态：已直接展示出版的真实区位总图、组合平面及三张剖面／剖面立面图。没有把概念SVG冒充建筑师原件。原图缺完整可校准图签，因此不宣称测绘精度、统一比例或完整施工图。

Drawing status: actual published location plan, composite plan and three section/section-elevation images are displayed directly. Concept SVGs are not presented as originals. Missing calibrated title blocks prevent claims of survey precision, common scale or a complete construction set.
先证明哪里能走、哪里能看，再谈整合度。
Establish where people can walk and see before claiming integration.
本章是可检验的方法审计与空间阅读，不是已完成的Angular Integration、Choice或VGA计算。本站没有为04运行并校准正式句法模型，也没有可发布的实测人流。

This chapter audits a testable method and spatial reading. It is not a completed angular integration, choice or VGA calculation. No calibrated formal syntax model or measured pedestrian flow is published for case 04.
一套问题，三种模型
One set of questions, three different models

title: 01 / 城市网络
01 / Urban network
text: 检验车站—CBD—河岸的路径是否经过广场。输入需含真实步行路网、路口过街、开放时段与竖向连接；铁路和机动车道不得当作人行边。
Test whether station–CBD–river journeys pass through the square. Inputs need real pedestrian links, crossings, opening hours and level changes. Rail and traffic lanes cannot become pedestrian edges.

title: 02 / 广场视域
02 / Plaza visibility
text: 检验广场与Atrium入口是否相互可见。输入需分层步行多边形、墙、玻璃、台阶、坡地和临时遮挡。玻璃可见与可穿越要用两个属性。

Test intervisibility of plaza and Atrium entrances. Inputs need level-specific walkable polygons, walls, glass, stairs, slopes and temporary obstructions. Visibility and permeability require separate attributes.

title: 03 / 行为验证
03 / Behavioural validation
text: 区分穿行、等候、自由坐靠、消费与活动观众。按入口、时段和活动状态记录；观察数据与模型分开存档，再检验相关关系。
Separate through movement, waiting, free sitting, consumption and event attendance. Record entrance, time and event state; archive observations separately before testing relationships with models.
当前证据能支持什么
What the current evidence supports

text: 从可复核参数到结果复现
From auditable parameters to reproducible outputs
正式建模前，应冻结底图日期、数据许可、坐标系、模型边界与外侧缓冲区；人工审查跨层连接、过街、门禁及障碍物。记录轴线／线段建模规则、角度权重、半径、归一化与软件版本。VGA还需注明网格间距、观察高度、玻璃和地形处理规则。所有参数和几何应与结果一起公开。

Before formal modelling, freeze date, licence, CRS, boundary and external buffer. Audit level connections, crossings, doors and obstacles. Record axial/segment construction, angular weighting, radii, normalisation and software version. VGA also requires grid spacing, eye height, glass and terrain rules. Publish parameters and geometry with results.
01当前已有的探索性network reach使用长度加权最短路径；它不等于经典空间句法。04不能因章节名称相同就复制01数值。未来如复用该模块，应先用独立小图验证最短路径和半径截断，再报告连通分量、边界效应与未映射广场区域。

Case 01’s exploratory network reach uses length-weighted shortest paths; it is not classical Space Syntax. Sharing a chapter title does not justify copying its values to 04. Reusing that module would require independent checks of paths and radius clipping, plus connected components, boundary effects and unmapped plaza areas.

Case 01 algorithm and limitations: network reach

Return to original plan and inspect input boundaries

Falsifiable spatial hypotheses

Station arrival and cultural destinations jointly support use

Separate passage, institutional entry and staying; compare event and non-event days

Arrival produces little voluntary stay, or use appears only during events

Non-orthogonal edges create several spatial foci

Equal-period zonal observations plus layered visibility model

Atrium complements the outdoor plaza

Compare indoor/outdoor access and use across times
室内通行权、关闭时段或消费限制使连续性中断
Access restrictions, closing times or consumption requirements interrupt continuity

text: 没有现场采样，因而不发表人流因果结论；没有校准模型，因而不发表彩色热力图。空白结果是审计结论的一部分。
Without field sampling, no causal flow claim is published; without a calibrated model, no heatmap is produced. Missing results are part of the audit.
圣马可依靠连续柱廊组织边界；Federation Square依靠多栋建筑、开口与公共通廊共同组织边界。
San Marco organises its edge through continuous arcades; Federation Square combines separate buildings, openings and public passages.
立面图纸与立面照片必须分开
Keep elevation drawings distinct from elevation photographs
尺度章已展示带真实立面投影的城市剖面。下列为原刊标注的立面与城市界面照片，不把摄影写成正投影测绘图。当前未取得可校准的完整四向正立面套图；北侧、河侧、铁路侧及广场内侧按可核实的视点分别阅读。

The scale chapter displays a real urban section with projected elevations. The following are published facade and context photographs, not orthographic surveys. A calibrated four-direction elevation set is unavailable; read the documented street, river, rail and plaza-facing viewpoints separately.

Across-river photo, Atrium and river-end section

How civic space opens toward the river

text: Atrium：建筑内部也是公共空间研究对象
Atrium: building interiors as part of the civic-space study
与圣马可柱廊不同，Atrium不是仅附着在单侧立面上的浅进深边缘，而是可单独进入和穿行的覆盖空间。建筑师资料将其视为联系Flinders Street与河流的公共空间；实际通行时间、活动占用与无障碍路径仍应由现行运营信息或现场核验。

Unlike San Marco’s edge arcade, the Atrium is a covered space that can be entered and traversed in its own right. The architects describe a connection between Flinders Street and the river; current hours, event occupation and step-free continuity still require operational or field checks.

title: 表皮与开口
Cladding and openings
text: 石材、金属与玻璃在照片中形成不同透明程度。表皮图案提供识别，但不能代替入口可见性、可进入性和沿街活动的研究。
Stone, metal and glass present different apparent transparency. Cladding patterns create identity but cannot substitute for entry visibility, access or ground-level activity.

title: 地面与坐靠
Ground and seating edges
text: 坐靠照片显示部分高差被日常使用；这种现象值得记录，但不证明所有台阶满足舒适和无障碍需求。
Photographs show some level changes used as seats. This observation does not establish comfort or accessibility of all steps.

title: 室内与室外
Inside and outside
text: Atrium提供覆盖条件，室外广场支持更大规模聚集。两者互补的判断需要比较活动布置与普通时段，而非只看建筑空景。
Atrium provides cover while the plaza supports larger gatherings. Their complementarity needs event/non-event comparison rather than empty architectural images alone.
人与建筑的尺度：从图纸回到视点
Human scale: from drawings back to viewpoints
观察顺序：先定位公共地面，再辨认首层开口、坐靠、遮蔽与文化入口，最后查看是否允许不消费的停留。建筑高度、街墙连续率和首层开放比例没有可靠实测来源，暂不填写数字。

Read public ground first, then openings, seating edges, cover and cultural entrances, and finally whether staying requires consumption. No reliable measured heights, edge-continuity ratios or ground-floor openness percentages are available, so no numbers are invented.
同一片地面：从午间停留，到文化活动、节庆与公共表达。
One ground: everyday pauses, cultural events, festivals and civic expression.
日常使用与活动档案分别阅读。气候不单独设章，遮蔽、雨天路径、日晒与活动时段作为使用条件纳入讨论；本案未开展热舒适或风环境实测。

Read everyday use separately from event archives. Cover, rain routes, sun and timing are conditions of use within this chapter, without a separate climate chapter. No thermal-comfort or wind measurements have been undertaken.
01 / 普通时段：停留、穿行与消费
01 / Everyday: staying, passing and consumption
坐在地面边缘与穿行的照片确认这些使用确实发生，但照片的选择由设计方完成，时间未知，存在展示偏差。应在工作日／周末、午间／傍晚、活动／无活动、室外／Atrium分别采样，区分自由停留与商业座位。

Photographs establish that sitting at edges and walking occur, but designer selection and unknown timing introduce display bias. Sample weekdays/weekends, lunch/evening, event/non-event and outdoor/Atrium conditions separately, distinguishing informal stay from commercial seating.
02 / 文化活动：从舞台到室内公共通廊
02 / Cultural events: screen, stage and covered passage
大屏幕和临时座椅显示可被布置的活动地面；开幕夜Atrium照片由2003年原刊确认。两种场景说明室内外可承载不同活动，不能据此证明全年活动频率、总参与人数或不设门槛的使用权。

Screen and temporary seating show a programmable ground; the 2003 publication identifies the Atrium opening-night scene. The images show different indoor/outdoor uses but cannot establish annual frequency, total attendance or unrestricted access.
03 / 节庆：地面与城市天际线共同成为背景
03 / Festivals: ground and skyline as a shared setting
州图书馆将焰火照片标注为2015年。节庆使广场成为城市集体观看的地点，同时带来临时设施、通行和人群管理问题。这里不从图像估计容量，也不把举办过一次活动解释为目前仍按同样规则运营。

The library dates the fireworks image to 2015. Celebration makes the square a shared viewing place while introducing temporary infrastructure and crowd-management demands. Capacity is not inferred, and a past event does not establish current operating rules.
04 / 公共集会：公共性还包括表达与争论
04 / Assemblies: publicness includes expression and disagreement
2003年和平集会照片确认广场具有公共表达的历史用途。2019年遗产委员会决定进一步提供关于公共空间价值的制度性证据。照片与登记决定相互补充，但都不能替代当前活动许可、安保边界或自主使用规则的核查。

The 2003 peace-rally image documents a civic-expression use. The 2019 heritage determination provides institutional evidence of civic value. These sources complement one another without replacing checks of present permits, security boundaries or informal-use rules.

text: 三条可迁移原则
Three transferable principles

title: 先建立可用的公共地面
Establish usable civic ground
text: 基础设施上盖必须与周边过街、室内通廊和河岸路线一起设计；几何连续不代表公共使用连续。
Design the deck with crossings, covered passages and river routes. Geometric continuity does not automatically provide continuous public use.

title: 让文化入口与自由停留并存
Combine cultural entry and informal stay
text: 公共空间不应只有进馆和消费两种目的；通过座位、边缘和通行路径给自主停留留下位置。
Museum entry and consumption should not be the only purposes. Seating, edges and routes should also accommodate voluntary informal stay.

title: 把运营当作空间条件
Treat operations as a spatial condition
text: 临时围栏、活动搭建和开放时间会改变平面可达性；应将它们纳入验证，而非以建筑照片代替。
Fencing, event installations and hours change access. Include them in verification rather than relying on architecture photographs.
资料与图像出处
Sources and image provenance
证据等级：S1原始设计／官方资料，S2可靠出版与机构档案，S3 GIS几何，S4研究推断。图纸和照片的图注均保留来源、作者或署名缺口、年代及版权状态。图片在原出版服务器上直接显示，不将第三方受版权保护的文件复制入仓库。

Evidence classes: S1 original design/official records; S2 published and institutional archives; S3 GIS geometry; S4 interpretation. Captions retain provenance, creator or credit gap, date and rights. Third-party images display from publisher servers and are not copied into the repository.
